newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: RUGBY UNION-FITZPATRICK LEADS POWERFUL BARBARIANS SIDE.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-FITZPATRICK LEADS POWERFUL BARBARIANS SIDE.

text.p: Fitzpatrick will lead a powerful New Zealand Barbarians side on
a two-match tour of England next month.
Fitzpatrick, capped 83 times for his country, captained New
Zealand to their first series win in South Africa this year.
The side includes giant winger Jonah Lomu, who has had
fitness problems this year, plus full-back Christian Cullen, who
succeeded Lomu this season as the All Blacks' most exciting
The side, announced on Tuesday, will play the North of
England on November 24 followed by a match against England at
